name: Uchuu Bouken Shoujo Nami Davie Jones ~Umi no Akuma~
original_name: 宇宙冒険少女ＮＡＭＩ Ｄａｖｉｅ Ｊｏｎｅｓ ～海の悪魔～
source:
In 2991 in addition to speed of light space navigation humankind acquired the technology of hyper jump system (HJS) from ruins of ancient alien civilization. The government now succeeded in production of minimized versions of such hyper portals and one such device was planted in the suitcase of space delivery company pilot Nami.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-june-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2991年，人类除了能以光速进行宇宙航行，还从古代外星文明遗迹中获得了超空间跳跃系统（HJS）技术。政府如今成功制造出这种超空间传送门的微型版本，其中一台设备便被装进宇宙快递公司飞行员奈美的手提箱里。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-june-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
